root_cause: crontab(5) documents that this cron daemon does not support per-user timezones; CRON_TZ/TZ affect child commands but not trigger evaluation. The daemon was using Europe/Madrid CEST for the calendar fields.

cron_verification.documentation_evidence: crontab(5) LIMITATIONS: cron runs with a defined timezone and does not support per-user timezones

corrected_mechanism: systemd user timers with OnCalendar expressions carrying an explicit UTC suffix

dst_simulation.summer: systemd-analyze calendar normalizes to UTC and displays CEST locally; trigger remains UTC
dst_simulation.winter: systemd-analyze calendar normalizes to UTC and displays CET locally; trigger remains UTC
